[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Makes a minor consistency edit between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057][b]Farm Animal Facelift[/b][/url] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/b].
